Hero.title: Building the future through <accent>Full-stack Architecture</accent>
Hero.subtitle: Hello, I'm <bold>Nguyen Van Cong</bold>, a Full-stack Developer passionate about building robust, scalable systems and elegant digital solutions. Ready to turn your ideas into reality.

About.title: About Me
About.bio_p1: I am a final-year IT student focused on Backend System Design, SaaS Architecture, and Cloud Infrastructure.
About.bio_p2: I specialize in building scalable SaaS platforms with NestJS, Prisma, and PostgreSQL. I'm proficient in implementing real-time features, Redis caching, and advanced authorization using CASL. On the frontend, I utilize Next.js and Zustand for high-performance state management.

Projects.title: Selected Works
Projects.ecommerce_desc: Built a scalable SaaS backend with NestJS and Prisma, implementing CASL for fine-grained authorization, Redis caching, and AWS deployment.
Projects.healthcare_desc: Developed a full-stack platform using Next.js and MongoDB, featuring real-time chat, Zustand state management, and secure AWS S3 storage.
Projects.edtech_desc: Modern personal portfolio website built with Next.js and high-performance glassmorphism aesthetics.
